result.summary: Read the full current design doc (lib/letflow/design/iss0381-dlq-entry-insert-changeset-fix.md, all 329 lines), not just Section 6. Ran independent greps against the whole file: `grep -n '|>'` -> no matches; a map-literal `key: value` (atom/number/[]/string/DateTime/Map./%{) pattern grep -> only false-positive substring hits inside `Map.take/2` prose references (lines 16, 77), no actual map-literal syntax; a bracket-index grep (`[0-9]+]` or `word[`) -> no matches; a `%{` grep -> no matches; a fenced-code-block grep (```) -> no matches; a `Module.function(` call-with-args grep -> only two hits, both type-spec notation (`Entry.t()`, `String.t()`, `Ecto.Changeset.t()`), not callable expressions with real arguments. Confirmed via `git show 65396f18` that the only diff in the final rework commit is the Section 6 sentence describing enqueue/2's default-value merge, rephrased from literal `status: :pending`, `retry_count: 0`, `retry_history: []`, `created_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second)` into prose ('a pending status, a zero retry count, an empty retry history, and a created_at timestamp derived from the current UTC time truncated to second precision') -- a 4-line/3-line narrow diff, nothing else touched. D1 re-confirmed intact: Section 3 still states cast/3 currently has 17 elements, 5 REMOVED (tenant_id, status, retry_count, retry_history, created_at), 12 remain, full per-row disposition table (rows 1-17) present and unaltered, cross-checked against enqueue/2's 12-key Map.take/2 allowlist. Section 9's fail-first proof re-confirmed intact and unaltered: changeset-level test construction bypassing enqueue/2, the status/retry_count/retry_history value-divergence fail-first assertions, and the tenant_id/created_at malformed-UUID/malformed-timestamp mechanism-divergence proof (cast/3's type-cast 'is invalid' error vs put_change/3's bypass of type validation) are all present with the explicit DESIGN NOTE to TEST-DESIGNER. Design is genuinely clean after three rework rounds. Routing to ELIXIR-DEV for WF-03 Step 3 implementation.
